Title: The Hebrew Midwives Defy Pharaoh
DateApprox: c. 1446 BC or c. 1270 BC (date debated by tradition)
Events: Pharaoh orders the Hebrew midwives Shiphrah and Puah to kill newborn Hebrew sons, but the midwives fear God and let the children live. God deals well with the midwives, and Pharaoh then commands all Egypt to throw Hebrew sons into the river.
